dataset.name: Synthetic demonstration production (SYN-A, SYN-B, SYN-C)
dataset.banner: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA - not MOIL operational records. Forecasts and risk bands illustrate the workflow only.

provenance.label: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA
provenance.description: Deterministic daily production records for fictional mines SYN-A, SYN-B and SYN-C. Planned and actual tonnes, equipment downtime, weather and blasting delays, and rainfall are generated from simple, documented rules.
provenance.licence: Not applicable (synthetic data generated for this demonstration).
limitations: Not MOIL operational data and not calibrated to any real mine.
Relationships between delays and output are designed into the generator; associations found in this dataset describe the generator, not real operations.
Rainfall is synthetic here. Enrich the dataset with a public rainfall series to replace it.

recommendations.title: Prepare a recovery plan for the forecast shortfall
recommendations.summary: The forecast is 23.8% below plan over the next 30 days (HIGH risk band).
recommendations.reasoning: The forecast gap is what the operation should expect if current conditions continue. A recovery plan shows how much daily uplift the plan would need.
suggested_actions: Decide whether the plan or the operating assumptions should change before the period starts.
Check which zones could add about 208 t per day, the size of the forecast gap (6,242 t over 30 days), before the plan itself is changed.
Re-run the forecast after each week of actuals to check whether the gap is closing.

expected_impact.basis: Arithmetic on the forecast: the net gap over 30 days divided by 30 days gives an uplift of 208 t per day (23.8% of average daily plan). This is the size of the gap, not a forecast of what an action would recover.

reasons: Rule thresholds are policy choices, not learned parameters.

limitations: The forecast assumes operational inputs stay at their trailing averages.
The interval is empirical from backtest windows; see the risk page.

recommendations.title: Investigate the persistent production shortfall against plan
recommendations.summary: Attainment is 76.5% against a 97% target, and 100% of matched days were below plan.
recommendations.reasoning: A shortfall on most days, rather than on a few outliers, suggests the plan is out of step with demonstrated output or that a common constraint is being missed.
suggested_actions: Hold a daily plan-versus-actual review with a root-cause code for every shortfall day.
Test whether the plan is achievable: compare it with the trailing 28-day output by zone.
Start with the zone that contributes most of the gap (see the zone-concentration recommendation, if any).

evidence.metric: Gap to plan on matched days

expected_impact.basis: Closing the gap depends on which causes the review finds, so no impact is estimated.

reasons: Rule thresholds are policy choices, not learned parameters.

limitations: Gap is measured on matched days only. Pending days are excluded.

recommendations.title: Review recurring equipment downtime in zone SYN-A-Z2
recommendations.summary: 43% of zone-days in the last 28 days had more than 8 hours of equipment downtime.
recommendations.reasoning: Repeated heavy-downtime days point to a recurring equipment or maintenance problem rather than one-off failures, and they are a material constraint on output in this zone.
suggested_actions: Pull the breakdown log for SYN-A-Z2 for the last 90 days and group failures by equipment and cause.
Check whether repeated failures share a component, operator shift or maintenance interval.
Agree a preventive maintenance or spares plan for the top recurring cause before the next monsoon.

expected_impact.basis: Mean output on normal-downtime days minus heavy-downtime days in this zone's history (132 t per day), times the 12 heavy day(s) in the window. This is an association in the data, not a measured effect of removing downtime.

reasons: Rule thresholds are policy choices, not learned parameters.

limitations: The dataset does not record failure causes or equipment IDs.
Output differences are associations and may reflect other conditions on heavy-downtime days.
